note.ja: 半解析解 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。 長時間第一原理NVE、一般の多軌道直交制約・SCF誤差、電子/核の一般熱浴、正準平衡・断熱分離・エルゴード性、実物質は未検証。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units. Long first-principles NVE, general multi-orbital orthonormality/SCF errors, general electronic/nuclear baths, canonical equilibration, adiabatic/ergodic certification and materials remain unverified.
